paragraphs: DigitalOptometrics is a technology company whose software lets a patient sitting in an optical exam location receive a comprehensive eye examination from a licensed optometrist working somewhere else. The exam and the prescription are meant to be done in under 30 minutes.

The visit starts with preliminary testing carried out on site in the clinical area. A video slit lamp records high-definition footage of the outside structures of the eye for the remote doctor to evaluate. That doctor can control the phoropter remotely and reviews the findings in real time. A comprehensive exam is described as covering ten subject areas, including a vision analysis. At the end the optometrist finalizes and delivers the glasses or contact lens prescription within minutes.

Buyers are optical providers, and the company describes itself as optometrist founded and optometrist driven. Dr. Fried formed the company in 2016 and assembled a team of optical software development specialists. The technology was shown publicly at the Vision Expo in New York City. The company states that its system is used in more than 30 states in the United States and in Canada.
